description: Expands tabs into four spaces in the C sources of a tree while a Makefile and a vendored folder keep their tabs. DISTILL-CANARY-e740edce

files.src/README.txt:
Source notes

Indent C sources with 4 spaces instead of tabs.
Makefile recipes require real tabs, and src/vendor is third-party code kept byte-for-byte.

turns.prompt: Replace every tab with four spaces in the .c and .h files under src. src/README.txt lists what must keep its tabs. Check the result and reply DONE.
